40184-the-natural-cure-of-consumption-co.title: A Health Manual For The People.
40184-the-natural-cure-of-consumption-co.creator: Unknown
40184-the-natural-cure-of-consumption-co.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. arrive at just conclusions otherwise. The liability to error is increased many fold when the subject is not merely not popular, but is, in fact, _un_-popular. It is a prevalent custom to “skim over” a volume, and then praise or condemn it, according to the reader’s preconceived notion.

arxiv-2102-09020.title: Linear Nearest Neighbor Flocks with All Distinct Agents
arxiv-2102-09020.creator: R. Lyons, J. J. P. Veerman
arxiv-2102-09020.description: Abstract This paper analyzes the global dynamics of 1-dimensional agent arrays with nearest neighbor linear couplings. The equations of motion are second order linear ODE’s with constant coefficients. The novel part of this research is that the couplings are different for each distinct agent.

arxiv-2107-02367.title: Discrete-Valued Neural Communication
arxiv-2107-02367.creator: Dianbo Liu*, Alex Lamb*, Kenji Kawaguchi, Anirudh Goyal, Chen Sun, Michael Curtis Mozer, Yoshua Bengio, * co-first author
arxiv-2107-02367.description: Abstract Deep learning has advanced from fully connected architectures to structured models organized into components, e.g., the transformer composed of positional elements, modular architectures divided into slots, and graph neural nets made up of nodes. In structured models, an interesting question is how to conduct dynamic and possibly sparse communication among the separate components.

arxiv-2110-15389.title: Ley de Reciprocidad Cuadrática y aplicaciones
arxiv-2110-15389.creator: Mario Pérez Maletzki
arxiv-2110-15389.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Mario Pérez Maletzki. El objetivo de este trabajo es introducir todos los conceptos y resultados necesarios para finalmente poder dar una demostración rigurosa de la Ley de Reciprocidad Cuadrática y ver como podemos aplicarla para obtener resultados de teoría de números que distan mucho de ser triviales tales como el problema de los dos cuadrados, el problema de determinar cuándo una ecuación en congruencias de segundo grado tiene solución y otros.

arxiv-2202-01993.title: Grounding Answers for Visual Questions Asked by Visually Impaired People
arxiv-2202-01993.creator: Chongyan Chen, Samreen Anjum, Danna Gurari, University of Texas at Austin University of Colorado Boulder
arxiv-2202-01993.description: Abstract Visual question answering is the task of answering questions about images. We introduce the VizWiz-VQA-Grounding dataset, the first dataset that visually grounds answers to visual questions asked by people with visual impairments. We analyze our dataset and compare it with five VQA-Grounding datasets to demonstrate what makes it similar and different.

arxiv-2204-10715.title: Equivalent definitions of Arthur packets for real unitary groups
arxiv-2204-10715.creator: Nicolas Arancibia Robert, Paul Mezo
arxiv-2204-10715.description: Abstract Mok and Moeglin-Renard have defined Arthur packets for unitary groups. Their definitions follow Arthur’s work on classical groups and rely on harmonic analysis. For real groups there is an alternative definition of Arthur packets, due to Adams-Barbasch-Vogan. It relies on sheaf-theoretic techniques instead of harmonic analysis.

arxiv-2208-14795.title: Ant Colony Optimization for Mining Gradual Patterns
arxiv-2208-14795.creator: Dickson Odhiambo Owuor, Thomas Runkler, Anne Laurent, Joseph Onderi Orero, Edmond Odhiambo Menya
arxiv-2208-14795.description: Abstract Gradual pattern extraction is a field in Knowledge Discovery in Databa-ses that maps correlations between attributes of a data set as gradual dependencies. A gradual dependency may take the form: “the more Attribute K , the less Attribute L ” . Classical approaches for extracting gradual patterns extend either a breath-first search or a depth-first search strategy.

arxiv-2303-02992.title: Normalization flow
arxiv-2303-02992.creator: Dmitry Treschev
arxiv-2303-02992.description: Abstract We propose a new approach to the theory of normal forms for Hamiltonian systems near a non-resonant elliptic singular point. We consider the space of all Hamiltonian functions with such an equilibrium position at the origin and construct a differential equation in this space. Solutions of this equation move Hamiltonian functions towards their normal forms.

arxiv-2404-18469.title: Error-Resilient Weakly Constrained Coding via Row-by-Row Coding
arxiv-2404-18469.creator: Prachi Mishra and Navin Kashyap
arxiv-2404-18469.description: Abstract A weakly constrained code is a collection of finite-length strings over a finite alphabet in which certain substrings or patterns occur according to some prescribed frequencies. Buzaglo and Siegel (ITW 2017) gave a construction of weakly constrained codes based on row-by-row coding, that achieved the capacity of the weak constraint.

arxiv-2410-23635.title: Spatiotemporal pattern formation of membranes induced by surface molecular binding/unbinding
arxiv-2410-23635.creator: Hiroshi Noguchi
arxiv-2410-23635.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hiroshi Noguchi. Nonequilibrium membrane pattern formation is studied using meshless membrane simulation. We consider that molecules bind to either surface of a bilayer membrane and move to the opposite leaflet by flip–flop. When binding does not modify the membrane properties and the transfer rates among the three states are cyclically symmetric, the membrane exhibits spiral-wave and homogeneous-cycling modes at high and low binding rates, respectively, as in an off-lattice cyclic Potts model.

arxiv-2411-05696.title: A gradient flow perspective on McKean-Vlasov equations in econophysics Thanks: The author received support from the NDSEG fellowship and extends warm thanks to B. Boghosian, M. Johnson, D. Gentile, C. Smith, and B. Mallery, all of Tufts University, for patient listening and feedback. I thank the ano
arxiv-2411-05696.creator: David W. Cohen
arxiv-2411-05696.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by David W. Cohen. We prove that the Gini coefficient of economic inequality is a Lyapunov functional for a class of nonlinear, nonlocal integro-differential equations arising at the intersection of mathematics, economics, and statistical physics. Next, a novel Riemannian geometry is imposed on a subset of probability densities such that the evolutionary dynamics are formally driven by the Gini coefficient functional as a gradient flow.

arxiv-2501-08118.title: Revisiting Birds Eye View Perception Models with Frozen Foundation Models: DINOv2 and Metric3Dv2
arxiv-2501-08118.creator: Seamie Hayes, Ganesh Sistu, Ciaran Eising
arxiv-2501-08118.description: Abstract Birds Eye View perception models require extensive data to perform and generalize effectively. While traditional datasets often provide abundant driving scenes from diverse locations, this is not always the case. It is crucial to maximize the utility of the available training data.

arxiv-2510-10962.title: MC#: Mixture Compressor for Mixture-of-Experts Large Models Thanks: Wei Huang, Jianhui Liu, Haoru Tan, Shiming Zhang and Xiaojuan Qi are with the Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering, The University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR. Email: weih@connect.hku.hk, jhliu0212@gmail.co
arxiv-2510-10962.creator: Wei Huang, Yue Liao, Yukang Chen, Jianhui Liu, Haoru Tan, Si Liu
arxiv-2510-10962.description: Abstract Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has emerged as an effective and efficient scaling mechanism for large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). By expanding a single feed-forward network into multiple expert branches, MoE increases model capacity while maintaining efficiency through sparse activation.

arxiv-2510-22501.title: A Novel Discrete-time Model of Information Diffusion on Social Networks Considering Users Behavior † Faculty of Information Technology. ‡ Department of Information Security. § Faculty of Fundamental Sciences.
arxiv-2510-22501.creator: Tran Van Khanh † , Do Xuan Cho ‡ , Hoang Phi Dung §
arxiv-2510-22501.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce the SDIR (Susceptible–Delayable–Infected–Recovered) model, an extension of the classical SIR epidemic framework, to provide a more explicit characterization of user behavior in online social networks. The newly merged state D (delayable) represents users who have received the information but delayed its spreading and may eventually choose not to share it at all.

arxiv-2602-15149.title: SoliDualSPHysics: An extension of DualSPHysics for solid mechanics with hyperelasticity, plasticity, and fracture
arxiv-2602-15149.creator: Mohammad Naqib Rahimi, George Moutsanidis
arxiv-2602-15149.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Mohammad Naqib Rahimi, George Moutsanidis. We introduce SoliDualSPHysics, a novel open-source and GPU-accelerated software that extends DualSPHysics to enable the numerical simulation of hyperelastic, finite-strain plastic, and brittle fracture behavior in deformable solids within a unified smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) formulation. The software implements a total Lagrangian formulation for solid mechanics that allows direct application of external loads and boundary conditions, enabling independent solid mechanics simulations.

europmc-pmc5030358.title: Bacteriome and Mycobiome Interactions Underscore Microbial Dysbiosis in Familial Crohn's Disease.
europmc-pmc5030358.creator: Hoarau G, Mukherjee PK, Gower-Rousseau C, Hager C, Chandra J, Retuerto MA, Neut C, Vermeire S, Clemente J, Colombel JF, Fujioka H, Poulain D, Sendid B, Ghannoum MA.
europmc-pmc5030358.description: Unlabelled Crohn's disease (CD) results from a complex interplay between host genetic factors and endogenous microbial communities. In the current study, we used Ion Torrent sequencing to characterize the gut bacterial microbiota (bacteriome) and fungal community (mycobiome) in

pmc-10736183.title: Comparison of The Thickness of Free Anterolateral Thigh Flap in Different Fascial Planes: Clinical Results of Subfascial and Superficial Fat Flap
pmc-10736183.creator: Yavuz Tuluy, Zülfükar Ulaş Bali, Merve Özkaya Ünsal, Aziz Parspancı, Levent Yoleri, Çağla Çiçek, Gaye Taylan Filinte
pmc-10736183.description: Background The anterolateral thigh (ALT) flap is a preferred option in the reconstruction of a wide variety of defects, enabling multiple tissue components and thicknesses. Methods This study was conducted to investigate the correlation of the thickness of the traditional subfascial ALT flap and superficial fat flap with age, gender, and body mass index (BMI).

pmc-11351930.title: Dynamics of Leukocyte Telomere Length in Patients with Fabry Disease
pmc-11351930.creator: Tina Levstek, Nika Breznik, Bojan Vujkovac, Albina Nowak, Katarina Trebušak Podkrajšek, Michael Fossel, Kurt Whittemore
pmc-11351930.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Fabry disease (FD) leads to significant morbidity and mortality, which may indicate accelerated ageing. However, it is still unclear whether there is a relationship between telomere length (TL), a marker of biological ageing, and disease outcome. We aimed to examine the relationship between leukocyte TL (LTL) dynamics and the presence of advanced disease stages and/or late complications of FD, including hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, nephropathy and stroke, both cross-sectionally and longitudinally.

pmc-12403526.title: Effectiveness and safety of pirfenidone for radiation-induced lung injury in non-small cell lung cancer: a retrospective pilot study
pmc-12403526.creator: Xian Liu, Fangyang Lu, Hangli Yang, Guanghui Liao, Lili Zhao, Dan Zou, Tianchu He, Yong Hu, Lingyun Wang, Ji Xia, Benlan Li, Zhongjun Huang, Minfang Wang, Bing Lu, Shengfa Su, Jie Peng
pmc-12403526.description: BackgroundRadiotherapy (RT) remains a cornerstone in the treatment of thoracic malignancies; however, approximately one-third of patients with non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) develop Grade ≥ 2 radiation-induced lung injury (RILI). Despite its clinical significance, no pharmacologic standard of care has been established for RILI.

pmc-12472885.title: Hear My Voice! The Experience of Self-Advocacy Among Patients with Enterostomy: A Qualitative Study
pmc-12472885.creator: Yanlin Shen, Yashi Zou, Juan Du, Shaoqi Chen, Jing Tan, Huijuan Ma
pmc-12472885.description: Objective: This qualitative study aimed to understand the experience of self-advocacy among patients with enterostomy and to identify the behaviors, influencing factors, and benefits of self-advocacy. Methods: A descriptive phenomenological method was used, and the study was conducted from April to June 2024.

pmc-12534109.title: Severe Hypokalemic Paralysis Unmasking Renal Tubular Acidosis in a Patient With Sjögren’s Syndrome
pmc-12534109.creator: Harisanth Rajaram, Sherwin Ganegoda, Kesavan Sivanesan, Aishwarya Chitnis, Naim Ahmadouk
pmc-12534109.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Hypokalemic periodic paralysis (HPP) is a rare but life-threatening complication in patients with Sjögren’s syndrome (SS), often due to distal renal tubular acidosis (RTA) caused by autoimmune-mediated renal damage. We report a case of a woman in her 30s with a history of rheumatoid arthritis and SS who presented with acute, flaccid paralysis secondary to profound hypokalemia from distal RTA, requiring intensive care support. This patient was treated with central potassium and bicarbonate replacement, leading to marked clinical improvement.

pmc-12785828.title: Mechanisms of Dural Involvement in Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy
pmc-12785828.creator: Marialuisa Zedde, Fabrizio Piazza, Rosario Pascarella
pmc-12785828.description: Highlights What are the main findings? This study identifies the potential involvement of the dura mater and its lymphatic system in the pathophysiology of Cerebral Amyloid Angiopathy (CAA), suggesting that these structures may play a role in the clearance of amyloid-beta (Aβ) and maintenance of cerebrospinal fluid homeostasis.

pmc-13275317.title: Assessing efficacy of ADCY10 inhibitors in cervical mucus
pmc-13275317.creator: Justine Fischoeder, Jai G Marathe, Deborah J Anderson, Lonny R Levin, Jochen Buck, Carla Ritagliati
pmc-13275317.description: Male fertility depends on sperm motility, which enables sperm to traverse the female reproductive tract to the site of fertilization. Soluble adenylyl cyclase (sAC) is a key regulator of sperm motility, defining it as a promising non-hormonal contraceptive target for women and men.

pmc-13478617.title: Design of a low-power RISC-V based intelligent endoscopy detection processor: EndoRISC-V
pmc-13478617.creator: Amritha Anand, Saraswathy B, Sasipriya P, Anita Angeline A
pmc-13478617.description: Capsule endoscopy provides a non-invasive method for examining the gastrointestinal tract, but it generates more than 50,000 images which need several hours of manual examination. Real-time image processing in wearable receiver units could reduce the errors, but demand high computational throughput with low power and latency constraints.

pmc-13534579.title: Explainable and domain-adaptive prediction models for refrigerant charging in air conditioning systems within industrial processes
pmc-13534579.creator: Junwon Lee, Joonho Chang, Jinsoo Kim, Minsuk Kwak, Heechul Jung
pmc-13534579.description: Accurate prediction of refrigerant deficiency in consumer air conditioning (AC) systems is critical for optimizing energy efficiency and operational stability. However, existing data-driven models often suffer from significant performance degradation due to domain shift across different AC types and a lack of explanatory transparency.

pmc-13575305.title: Trends in Prevalence of Opioid Dependence in Scotland 2014–2023: Multi‐Parameter Estimation of Prevalence
pmc-13575305.creator: Andreas Markoulidakis, Matthew Hickman, Megan Glancy, Andrew McAuley, Lee R. Barnsdale, Tara Shivaji, Craig Collins, Jaroslaw Lang, Femke de Wit, Gordon Hunt, Sharon J. Hutchinson, Louisa Degenhardt, Hayley E. Jones
pmc-13575305.description: IntroductionScotland remains in the midst of a public health crisis driven by drug‐related deaths, with rates reaching 2.0 per 100 person‐years in 2020–22. Estimates of the prevalence of opioid dependence are critical for supporting policy decisions and better understanding the factors behind this rise.

(a) Establishment and operation of Account (1) Establishment There is created within the Federal Supplementary Medical Insurance Trust Fund established.
